function: Excluded: the learned mean field actor-critic selects each UE's fluid-antenna port and its opportunistic scheduling, with no BS precoder, beam, or RIS phase to design (pp. 1, 3).
notes: Excluded under function (check 5). Check 4 is passed because the action holds a physical-layer decision learned jointly with a scheduling decision: p. 3: "The action space of each UE is the port selection decision and the opportunistic scheduling decision". The learned decisions are the UE-side port of a fluid antenna and user access in fluid antenna multiple access, where the BS does no precoding: p. 1: "resource block without precoding". None of the seven areas is solved: there is no BS precoder, beam, or RIS phase shift, no detection, no channel estimation, no ISAC, no NTN, and no over-the-air aggregation. Borderline: a reviewer who reads fluid-antenna port selection as a receive-side beam selection would place the work in area 3. The PDF is the preprint (journal-class template, no DOI printed), identified by its title.
